scope: Proposition 9.2 of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be any algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. A countable program of the kind in Definition 1.1, including all its prescribed ray choices, descends to a common countable algebraically closed subfield of k. After embedding that subfield in C, it gives a program with the same step types and relative signs, the same boundary coefficients, and the same singularity properties. In particular an infinite birational program over k would give an infinite birational program over C.
